summary: All five fresh tokenizer scales completed exactly 20,000 optimizer updates and all 20 preregistered held-out milestones. Final EMA clean, edge and temporal-change PSNR increased monotonically across the local ladder, with n16.6m leading the descriptive ranking at 36.1691 / 26.7739 / 27.4284 dB. The fixed final grid is synchronized for visual review; dynamics remains blocked.

observed: All five fresh arms completed exactly 20,000 optimizer updates and emitted all 20 preregistered held-out evaluations at 2,500 / 5,000 / 10,000 / 20,000 updates.
At 20,000 updates, EMA clean / edge / temporal-change PSNR increased from 12.0610 / 11.9328 / 11.4600 dB at n0.17m to 36.1691 / 26.7739 / 27.4284 dB at n16.6m.
All five arms retained n_latents=16 and d_bottleneck=16; no CR-TOK-0002 checkpoint was reused.
The final comparison grid, learning curves and descriptive selection are synchronized with SHA256 identities; visual acceptance remains pending.
interpretation: Under this single-seed fixed-20k protocol, the three preregistered final EMA metrics improve monotonically with tokenizer capacity, supporting the capacity-quality hypothesis.
The numerical ranking is descriptive rather than a quality gate, and it does not by itself establish that the reconstructions are visually acceptable.
not_established: Whether any tokenizer is visually acceptable.
Whether n16.6m supports controllable action-conditioned dynamics.
Whether the single-seed ranking generalizes beyond this dataset and training recipe.
decision: Proceed to the separately preregistered CR-TOK-0004 28.7M-label extension on the same A10.
Keep the n16.6m final comparison grid available for explicit user visual review.
